cases.prompt: We're a 10-person startup building a web app. Which project management tool should we use?

sources.title: Linear pricing
sources.text: Free plan up to 250 issues. Basic $8 per user per month, Business $14 per user per month (billed yearly). Built for software teams; deep GitHub and GitLab integration. G2 rating 4.6/5.

sources.title: Jira pricing - Atlassian
sources.text: Free for up to 10 users. Standard $7.53 per user per month. Scrum and Kanban boards, GitHub integration, steep learning curve. G2 rating 4.3/5.

sources.title: Asana pricing
sources.text: Free for up to 10 users. Starter $10.99 per user per month (billed yearly). Strong for cross-team projects; GitHub integration available. G2 rating 4.4/5.

sources.title: ClickUp pricing
sources.text: Free Forever plan. Unlimited $7 per user per month (billed yearly). Very flexible, can feel cluttered. GitHub integration. G2 rating 4.7/5.

sources.title: Notion pricing
sources.text: Free for individuals. Plus $10 per user per month (billed yearly). Docs and projects in one place; GitHub pull requests sync into databases. G2 rating 4.7/5.

sources.title: monday.com pricing
sources.text: Free for up to 2 seats. Basic $9 per seat per month, minimum 3 seats (billed yearly). Visual boards; GitHub integration. G2 rating 4.7/5.
